whatIsIt.title: What is a wallbox?
whatIsIt.description: A wall-mounted charger built for fast, everyday charging. It's a fixed charger installed in your garage that delivers far more power than the cable that comes with your car: instead of waiting all night, you charge in a couple of hours.

fastCharging.title: Charges up to 10 times faster
fastCharging.description: The car's emergency cable charges at 2.3 kW. A Rayforce wallbox charges at up to 22 kW.

vsCable.title: Built for daily use

cheaperThanPublic.title: Faster and cheaper than UTE's public chargers
cheaperThanPublic.description: You charge at home on a residential rate, without paying the public grid's price per kWh or waiting for a bay to free up.

whyBetter.title: Why get a wallbox if the cable that came with my car works fine?
whyBetter.description: Because "it works" isn't the same as being built for daily use. The cable that comes with your car is an emergency accessory: it charges slowly, lacks the protection of a fixed installation, and wears out much faster under everyday use.

protection.title: No fixed-installation protection
protection.description: The cable plugs straight into a regular outlet, with no dedicated protection against overload, short circuits or current leaks. A wallbox is installed with its own certified electrical protection.

app.title: Wears out with daily use
app.description: It's built for occasional charging, not to be plugged and unplugged every day for years. That speeds up wear on the plug and cable.

power.title: Keeps your car charging for hours longer
power.description: It charges at 2.3 kW versus up to 22 kW on a wallbox: the same charge takes several times longer, every single day.

Lineup.title: Find the wallbox that fits
Lineup.description: Four models in the BS20 line, from 7.2kW to 22kW, for charging at home or at work. They differ in power, in the supply they need, and in whether they come with a cable attached or a socket. Here is how to choose between them.

guide.title: Tips for choosing a wallbox charger

items.title: Start with your electrical supply
items.description: If your home is single-phase — the most common setup in Uruguay — a 7.2kW is your model. The 11 and 22kW need a three-phase supply: without one, the charger will not deliver that power.

items.title: Integrated cable or Type 2 socket
items.description: Buy one with an integrated cable if the charger is for your own car: charging is unhooking the cable and done, always on its holster, with nothing loose in the garage. Buy one with a socket if several cars will use it, since each arrives with its own cable and you are not betting on one suiting them all. Note: no cable is included.

items.title: More kW, fewer hours
items.description: A 7.2kW charges overnight comfortably for everyday use. The 11 and 22kW pay off when the car is shared between drivers or you cannot wait all night.

guide.footnote: All four models are Type 2, URSEA-approved and installed by our own team. If you are unsure about your supply, we confirm it during the technical visit.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.description: The questions we get most often: who we are, how we install and what happens after the purchase.

items.title: Who is Rayforce?
items.answer: We are the EV charging line of Bamibel S.A., a Uruguayan engineering company with over 25 years of experience. That track record stands behind every unit and every installation.

items.title: Are your units authorized by URSEA?
items.answer: Yes. Our full line of chargers for cars and trucks is registered with URSEA under authorization VU-SE-17-000123. The registry is public and you can look it up.

items.title: Who does the installation?
items.answer: We do, in house. We never subcontract: our engineers and UTE-certified electricians install every unit following Uruguayan electrical code.

items.title: What warranty do the units carry?
items.answer: One year of warranty, handled directly by us here in Uruguay. You do not depend on overseas service or a middleman importer.

items.title: What areas do you cover?
items.answer: We install in Montevideo and across the country. If you are outside the metro area, get in touch and we will arrange the site visit and timeline.

items.title: How can I pay?
items.answer: You can buy directly through MercadoPago on this site, or message us on WhatsApp to arrange other payment methods and get a quote with installation included.

items.title: Do you work with businesses, buildings and fleets?
items.answer: Yes. We handle projects for businesses, parking facilities, buildings and fleets, with 7, 11 and 22 kW units. Get in touch and we will scope it against your existing installation.

items.title: What happens after the purchase?
items.answer: You get local technical support: commissioning, Rayforce app setup and any questions afterwards. You message us and we handle it ourselves.
